headings: Economic risks related to our business
Risks related to the industry in which we operate
paragraphs: While we utilize robust processes and resources to identify and manage risks, we are subject to various risks and uncertainties in the course of our business, some of which are comparable to the risks any business is exposed to and some that are unique to our operations. The following summarizes the known material risks and uncertainties that may adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. When considering making or maintaining an investment in our securities, you should carefully consider the risk factors included below as well as those matters referenced in the section entitled Disclosures Regarding Forward-Looking Statements and other information included and incorporated by reference into this Annual Report on Form 10-K. These risks are not the only risks we face. Our business could also be impacted by additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we believe not to be material based on the information we have at this time. If any of the events described below as risks actually occur, it could materially harm our business, financial condition or results of operations or impair our ability to implement our business plans or complete development activities as expected. In that case, the market price of our common stock could decline or, if severe enough, the entire value of an investment in our securities could become worthless.

Volatility of natural gas, NGLs and oil prices affects our cash flow and capital resources and could significantly hamper our ability to operate economically. Natural gas, NGLs and oil prices are volatile, and a decline in prices could adversely affect our profitability and financial condition. As a commodity business, the oil and gas industry is typically cyclical and we expect the volatility to continue. Natural gas prices are likely to affect us the most because approximately 65% of our proved reserves were natural gas as of December 31, 2025 and, at times in the past, natural gas prices have been low compared to our costs to produce. Natural gas, NGLs and oil prices fluctuate in response to changes in supply and demand, market uncertainty and other factors that are beyond our control. These factors include:
• events that impact domestic and foreign supply of, and demand for, natural gas, NGLs and oil;

• the continued operation of export facilities to supply foreign markets with natural gas and natural gas liquids and the ability to transport the product to markets due to shipping restrictions, armed conflict or terrorist threats and attacks;
• changes in weather patterns and events, including natural disasters such as hurricanes, floods, wildfires and tornadoes;
• technological advances affecting energy consumption, storage and energy supply;

Management's Discussion of Critical Accounting Estimates
paragraphs: We are an independent natural gas, NGLs and oil company engaged in the exploration, development and acquisition of natural gas, NGLs and oil properties located in the Appalachian region of the United States. We operate in one segment and have a single company-wide management team that administers all properties as a whole rather than by discrete operating segments. We measure financial performance as a single enterprise and not on an area-by-area basis.

Our overarching business objective is to build stockholder value through returns-focused development of natural gas, NGLs and oil properties. Our strategy to achieve our business objective is to generate consistent cash flows from reserves and production through internally generated drilling projects occasionally coupled with complementary acquisitions and divestitures. Currently, our investment portfolio is focused on high quality natural gas and NGLs assets in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. Our revenues, profitability and future growth depend substantially on prevailing prices for natural gas, NGLs and oil and on our ability to economically find, develop, acquire, produce and sell these reserves.

Commodity prices have been and are expected to remain volatile. We believe we are well-positioned to manage any challenges that could occur during price variations and that we can endure the continued fluctuations in current and future commodity prices by:
• exercising discipline in our capital investments; • maintaining a competitive cost structure;
• diversifying sales outlets; • managing price risk through partial hedging of our production;
• maintaining a strong balance sheet; and
• optimizing drilling, completion and operational efficiencies.
Prices for natural gas, NGLs, and oil fluctuate widely and affect: • our revenues, profitability and cash flow;
• the amount of cash flow available to us for reinvestment or return to our stockholders; • the quantity of natural gas, NGLs and oil that we can economically produce;
• the quantity of natural gas, NGLs and oil shown as proved reserves; and
• our ability to borrow and raise additional capital, if needed.

We prepare our financial statements in conformity with U.S. GAAP, which require us to make estimates and assumptions that affect our reported results of operations and the amount of our reported assets, liabilities and proved natural gas, NGLs and oil reserves. We use the successful efforts method of accounting for our natural gas, NGLs and oil activities.

As we enter 2026, we believe we are positioned for sustainable long-term success. For 2026, we expect our capital budget to be in the range of $650 million to $700 million for natural gas, NGLs and oil related activities, excluding any potential acquisitions, for which we do not budget. As has been our historical practice, we will periodically review our capital expenditures throughout the year and may adjust the budget based on commodity prices, drilling success and other factors. We expect our 2026 capital budget to achieve modest growth in production relative to 2025 production, while also supporting our longer-term operational plans. Our 2026 capital budget is focused on generating free cash flow while efficiently developing our resource base to achieve competitive full cycle

管理層對關鍵會計估計的討論
paragraphs: 本公司為一間獨立的天然氣、NGLs 及石油公司，從事於美國阿巴拉契亞地區天然氣、NGLs 及石油資源的探勘、開發及收購業務。本公司經營一項應報告分部，並擁有單一公司層級的管理團隊，該團隊統一管理所有資源，而非分為不同的運營分部。本公司以整體企業為單位衡量財務表現，而非以地區為單位進行衡量。

本公司主要的業務目標為透過以回報為導向的天然氣、NGLs 及石油資源開發，來建立股東價值。為達成此業務目標，本公司策略為透過內部產生的鑽井專案，偶爾配合補充性的收購與處分，以產生穩定的現金流。目前，本公司投資組合主要聚焦於賓夕法尼亞州的高品質天然氣及 NGLs 資產。本公司之收入、獲利及未來成長，大幅取決於天然氣、NGLs 及石油的現行價格，以及本公司能否以經濟方式尋找、開發、收購、生產及銷售這些儲備資源。
天然氣、NGLs 及石油的價格一直以來都相當波動，且預期將持續如此。本公司認為本公司已具備足夠的條件，以應對價格變動期間可能出現的挑戰，並能承受目前及未來天然氣、NGLs 及石油價格的持續波動，具體方法為：
• 在資本投資上展現紀律；• 保持具競爭力的成本結構；
• 多元化銷售通路；• 透過部分對沖生產量來管理價格風險；
• 保持強固的資產負債表；以及
• 優化鑽井、完井及運營效率。
天然氣、NGLs 及石油的價格波動極大，並影響：• 本公司之收入、獲利及現金流；
• 我們可用於再投資或回饋股東的現金流量數量； • 我們能經濟性生產的天然氣、NGLs 以及石油數量；
• 顯示為已證實儲量的天然氣、NGLs 以及石油數量；以及
• 我們借款及籌集額外資金的能力，如有需要的話。
我們依照美國通用會計準則（U.S. GAAP）編製財務報表，這要求我們做出會影響我們營運成果報告以及我們報告資產、負債及已證實天然氣、NGLs 以及石油儲量數量的估計與假設。我們採用成功努力法（successful efforts method）來會計處理天然氣、NGLs 以及石油相關活動。

當我們邁入2026年時，我們相信我們已處於可實現可持續長遠成功的地位。對於2026年，我們預期與天然氣、NGLs 以及石油相關的資本預算將在6.5億至7億美元之間，不包括任何潛在收購活動，我們對此類活動並未列入預算。根據我們歷來的慣例，我們將在全年內定期審查資本支出，並根據商品價格、鑽井成果及其他因素調整預算。我們預期2026年的資本預算將實現相對於2025年生產量的溫和增長，同時也支持我們的長期運營計畫。我們2026年的資本預算重點在於產生自由現金流，同時高效開發我們的資源基礎，以實現具有競爭力的全週期

paragraphs: 雖然我們運用強大的流程與資源以識別並管理風險，但我們在營運過程中仍面臨各種風險與不確定性，其中一些風險與任何企業所面臨的風險相當，而另一些則是我們營運所特有的。以下總結了可能對我們業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生不利影響的已知重大風險與不確定性。在考慮是否投資或維持投資本公司證券時，您應謹慎考量下列風險因素，以及「前瞻性陳述揭露」部分及其他包含於本年度報告表10-K中之資訊。這些風險並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。我們的業務也可能受到其他尚未為我們所知或根據目前所掌握資訊，我們認為不具重大性之風險與不確定性之影響。若下列所列風險事件中任何一項實際發生，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大損害，或影響我們執行業務計畫或完成開發活動的能力建立。在此情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能會下跌，或在情況嚴重時，投資本公司證券的價值可能會完全喪失。

天然氣、NGLs（天然氣液化氣）與原油價格的波動會影響我們的現金流與資本資源，並可能嚴重影響我們以經濟方式運作的能力。天然氣、NGLs與原油價格具有高度波動性，價格下跌可能對我們的獲利能力與財務狀況造成不利影響。作為一個商品業，油氣產業通常具有週期性，我們預期這種波動性將持續。天然氣價格對我們的影響可能最大，因為截至2025年12月31日，我們已證實的儲備中約有65%為天然氣，而在過去某些時期，天然氣價格相較於我們的生產成本而言較低。天然氣、NGLs與原油價格會因供應與需求的變化、市場不確定性及其他我們無法控制的因素而波動。這些因素包括：
• 影響天然氣、NGLs與原油國內與國際供應與需求的事件；
• 維持出口設施運作以供應國際市場天然氣與天然氣液化氣，以及因運輸限制、軍事衝突或恐怖攻擊與威脅而影響產品運送到市場的能力；
• 天氣模式的變化與事件，包括天然災害如颶風、洪水、野火與龍捲風；
• 影響能源消耗、儲存與能源供應的科技進步；
